items.title: Fix IgnoreRules._hit for multi-segment unanchored directory patterns
items.why_now: High-severity bug: patterns like 'a/b' with dir_only=True fail to match 'a/b/c.py', causing files to be unexpectedly ignored or not ignored.

steps.do: Modify _hit method to join candidates for dir_only patterns with multiple segments before matching against pattern.
Add test for pattern 'a/b' (unanchored, dir_only) against path 'a/b/c.py' expecting True.
steps.verified_by: New test passes; existing ignore tests still pass.

items.assumption: The file daedalus/structcore/ignore.py exists and contains the _hit method. The test file tests/test_structcore_ignore.py exists (or can be created).

items.title: Add integration test for cancellation propagation from gate_candidates through run_attempt
items.why_now: High-severity: no integration test verifies that cancellation tokens propagate correctly across modules, risking hangs or ignored cancellations.

steps.do: Create test that calls gate_candidates with a cancel token, triggers a timeout, and verifies the runner stops within a reasonable time.
steps.verified_by: Test passes; grep for 'gate_candidates' and 'run_attempt' in test file.

items.assumption: The modules daedalus/kairos/gated_writes.py and daedalus/spine/attempt.py exist and can be imported in tests. The test file does not exist yet; needs creation.

items.title: Add re-verification before each os.rmdir/os.unlink in worktree.py to close TOCTOU window
items.why_now: High-severity: a TOCTOU race could allow a junction swap to redirect deletion outside the worktree, potentially deleting arbitrary files.

steps.do: Before each os.rmdir or os.unlink call, call _verify_reachable on the exact path again.
steps.verified_by: Run 'pytest tests/test_worktree_toctou.py' (new test) that simulates a race and expects safe behavior.

steps.do: Add test that attempts to exploit the TOCTOU window and verifies the operation is blocked or fails safely.
steps.verified_by: Test passes; existing worktree tests still pass.

items.assumption: The file daedalus/kairos/worktree.py exists and contains _verify_reachable and os.rmdir/os.unlink calls. Test file may need creation.

items.title: Add test verifying dry-run gate runs even when dry_run=True
items.why_now: Low severity but prevents future regression: the dependency on call order (screen_egress before early return) is fragile.

steps.do: Inspect publish_to_pr function to confirm screen_egress is called before dry_run check. Then add test that calls with dry_run=True and asserts gate logic executes.
Add test in a suitable test file (e.g., tests/test_bridge_enqueue_guard.py) that verifies gate runs even when dry_run=True.

items.assumption: The function publish_to_pr exists in daedalus/kairos/gated_writes.py. The test file may already exist; otherwise create.
